# Letters in the Ocean

> A quiet corner of the internet where strangers leave small pieces of kindness for each other. 

## About
Letters in the Ocean is an anonymous, ephemeral social experiment. There are no accounts, no profiles, no likes, and no endless feeds. 

## Rules
- You can find up to five bottles a day.
- You can leave or reply to one letter a day.
- Your letters are completely anonymous and unrecorded.

## Privacy
We do not collect personal information. We set a single, secure session cookie solely to enforce the daily limits.

## Source
This project is open-source and built with React, Vite, and Cloudflare Pages/Workers.
